unit: reference proposition within scenario and stage

categories.error: Reverses an empirical effect or the truth conditions of a proposition; quote both spans.
Drops or changes a population, time, eligibility or causal qualifier that changes warranted interpretation.
Alters recorded support, opposition or uncertainty counts; missing is a separate category.
Invents a source, changes attribution, or treats dependent reports as independent corroboration.
Omits a substantiated minority warning consequential under the frozen case-specific decision rule.
Adds an assertion not warranted by eligible input; distinguish a reported belief from a factual endorsement.
Converts absence of a valid rating into a participant stance or collective judgement.

severity.consequential: Changes the eligible proposition, evidence strength, panel position or prespecified decision-relevant warning.
severity.nonconsequential: Wording difference without such a change; do not count as primary error.

rules: Blind assessors to method and model; randomize output order.
Assessors initially score independently; retain original labels when adjudicating.
Missing output span is allowed for omissions; an omission needs an explicit reference span.
Mark genuinely ambiguous mappings unassessable and report coverage.
Distinguish fidelity to an expressed belief from factual truth.
